name: Teen Volunteer League
what_you_do: A six-week summer service-learning program. A cohort of teens meets weekly and works on service projects to build resume skills.
who_can_apply: Teens (the page does not state an age range). Slots are limited and filled through an application.
pay_detail: Unpaid. Up to 20 hours of volunteer service.
duration: 6 weeks, weekly sessions, up to 20 service hours
deadline_text: Applications typically open in April and are posted on the teen volunteering page. 2027 dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: Apply online when the form is posted. Look on the Pierce County Library page about teen volunteering.
notes: The page says teens attend weekly sessions for up to 20 service hours. The page does not state an age range or year. Work permit rule not stated.
